description: What waterproof mm and breathability g/m2 or RET ratings mean on rain jackets, how they trade off and what else decides a dry hike.
directAnswer: Waterproof ratings in mm show how much water pressure fabric resists, and breathability shows how well sweat escapes. About 10,000 mm suits moderate rain, with 10,000 or more g/m2/24h for active use.
